moments.title: I Cugini Invade My Home (Without Me)
moments.description: My friends—we call ourselves I Cugini ("The Cousins", a name the family tree only partially supports)—missed me so much that they invaded my home in Salerno for a movie night. Minor logistical detail: I live in Copenhagen. So they watched The Godfather on my couch, in my living room, while I attended my own house via video call. That's me on the phone. I have never felt so loved and so burgled at the same time.
moments.imageAlt: The Cugini gathered in Stefano's living room in Salerno with The Godfather on TV, holding up a phone with Stefano joining by video call from Copenhagen
